request.spec:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The header shows the signed-in user's own figures when a person on the sheet has the user's name
(by name or alias, as names are compared): that person's due-total and overdue-total; nothing when
there is no such person.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The header now shows your own due-total and overdue-total when someone on the sheet has your name, and nothing when no one does. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

- **The change:** it's all in `src/main/frontend/features/summary/Header.tsx`. I added two values after the sheet totals: `my-due-total` and `my-overdue-total`. The server, stored data and audit file are unchanged; this reuses figures the screen already loads.
- **How it finds you:** it looks for the person whose name or one of whose aliases matches your sign-in name, ignoring case and spaces at either end. That's how the server already compares names. Retired people count too.
- **The figures:** they're worked out exactly as that person's row shows them. So holds, the cap, late charges and grade changes all apply, and a due-total the row shows as "n/a" shows as "n/a" here too.
- **When there's no match:** both values are blank.
